Description: Dr. Rashad Khalifa delivers a sermon on the spiritual dangers of being unaware of God, citing Sura 7:179, 10:7, and 16:106 to argue that heedlessness leads to Hell. Dean Mahmoud contributes historical context regarding Jewish tribes in Medina who selectively obeyed Mosaic law by ransoming captives while simultaneously killing one another, drawing a parallel to modern Muslim nations like Iraq, Iran, Morocco, and the Polisario Front who pray but still wage war. Dr. Khalifa references Sura 15 to condemn those who divide the Quran to suit their desires. The study circle reads Sura 2:88-101, with Latifa reading verses 92-96 and Inga reading verses 97-101. Dr. Khalifa argues that Satan successfully deceived Christians into idolizing Jesus and has subtly done the same to Muslims regarding Muhammad through Hadith. Inga raises a question about Gabriel, prompting Dr. Khalifa to explain Gabriel's role in releasing the Quran from Muhammad's heart, asserting that all humans met God before birth but have had this memory obscured by their physical bodies. He shares a personal anecdote about an angel waking him for Fajr prayer with a warning in an Egyptian accent, and concludes with a story about a friend praising marijuana, which he claims led to a near-fatal gas furnace explosion as a spiritual reprimand.
